projects.objective: The main project or business that should receive attention first.
projects.policy: Protect delivery cadence. Research, automation and tooling should directly support useful output, growth, revenue or reliability. Do not let infrastructure work displace the primary project's real deliverables.

projects.objective: The second project or business priority.
projects.policy: Support the project without displacing the primary project's critical work. Prefer reusable research, outreach and automation patterns.

projects.objective: Maintain and improve the automation platform when doing so removes real work from active projects.
projects.policy: Avoid agent-framework churn. Prefer boring, inspectable components and improvements proven by real use.
